posts.title: Writing Posts for This Blog
posts.summary: A reference post showing every content block the blog supports, from headings and lists to code, quotes and images.

content.text: Every post on this site lives in `src/data/blogs.json`. Each one is a list of **content blocks**, and this post uses each block type once so you can copy whatever you need.
Inside any text you can write **bold**, *italic*, `inline code`, and [links](https://github.com/uzairafridi00). Links starting with `/` stay inside the site, like [the blog index](/blog).

items: Set `ordered` to `true` for a numbered list
Keep items short, one idea each

content.code:
from vllm import LLM, SamplingParams

llm = LLM(model="Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct")
out = llm.generate(["Hello!"], SamplingParams(max_tokens=64))
print(out[0].outputs[0].text)

content.text: A quote block, for pulling out a line worth remembering.
A callout highlights a note or warning. Posts with `"draft": true` are hidden from the site.

content.caption: Images take a path inside public/ or a full URL, plus an optional caption.
